title: List recurring Google Calendar dates with AI
h1: find the actual dates in a recurring calendar series
description: Turn a recurring Google Calendar meeting into actual dates, with cancellations marked and times in your zone. Get a four-week list in chat.
keyword: google calendar recurring event dates with ai
keywords: chatgpt list recurring google calendar events
answer: **hand the trainer real dates instead of saying every tuesday.** the bot finds your recurring google calendar event and lists its occurrences within a chosen window. include cancellations so nobody travels for a skipped session. this only lists dates, but dusk classes the action as a write. give it read and write access limited to this job.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: the series, expanded into actual dates.
what:
**get the next four weeks laid out in order.** name the repeating event and its calendar; your main calendar works too. the bot finds the series first.

name the time zone and ask for cancellations beside the scheduled dates. a long series can fill several batches, so tell it to keep going until it has the whole window.
uses: give a visiting trainer the dated sessions in a recurring course
spot a cancelled holiday-week session before anyone travels
list upcoming dates in your own recurring treatment series

routine.message: on the second tuesday of each month at 12:30, find the recurring kiln safety course on my training calendar. list the next four weeks in india time here for nikhil. keep going until all dates in that window are listed. mark cancellations and never count them as sessions to attend. never edit the series.
routine.when: second tuesday of each month at 12:30
routine.needs: google calendar with read and write; allow calendar and series lookups plus this action only
routine.output:
kiln safety course, next four weeks
india time
- 17 november, 10:00: scheduled
- 24 november: cancelled
- 1 december, 10:00: scheduled
- 8 december, 10:00: scheduled
24 november is a week off.

steps: connect google calendar. give the course name and the calendar it belongs to.
allow read and write for this action and its lookups. leave event edits outside the action list.
compare the short list with your calendar. look for the right time zone and marked cancellations.
schedule that same four-week search. look at the next runs and **Pause** when the course ends.
watch: **start with a repeating event.** a standalone appointment has no series to expand.
**a date window keeps the job manageable.** a request for every occurrence can run slowly or fail.
**use the dates for planning sessions.** an attendee limit can leave people out, so get attendance separately.

faq.q: will this change the repeating meeting?
faq.a: **no meetings change.** it only lists occurrences. dusk counts this action as a change, so read and write is still required.

faq.q: can it include the skipped dates?
faq.a: **yes, ask for cancelled occurrences too.** show their status beside each date and compare the short list with your calendar.

steps: name the calendar and repeating meeting
ask for the next four weeks in your time zone, including cancellations
compare one scheduled date and one skipped date with your calendar

mistakes.mistake: treating every returned date as a meeting to attend
mistakes.fix: show cancellation status beside each date.

mistakes.mistake: using it as a complete guest list
mistakes.fix: get attendance separately. the returned details can omit people.

tip.text: say the time zone in the request. a familiar meeting name is not enough.
